prompt: Which full-size pictures, if any, does Inez still need to download before making the trip export?
promptZh: 製作此行的匯出副本前，伊內絲還需要下載哪些完整圖片（如果有的話）？

options.zh: 只從〈讀取器設定〉下載 R17。
options.whyZh: R17 的完整圖可從另一條目已存的同 ID 檔案取得；仍缺的是新版標籤 C24。

options.zh: 只從〈線材標籤〉下載 C24。
options.whyZh: R17 可使用〈工作間套件〉已存的同 ID 完整圖；C19 和 C24 是不同圖片，C24 不能用舊完整圖替代。〈手勢〉只有文字且已儲存。

options.text: Both R17 and C24 from the three selected entries
options.zh: 從選定的三個條目中下載 R17 和 C24。
options.whyZh: C24 確實需要下載，但完整的 R17 已存在，雖然是儲存在未選取的條目下，仍可依 ID 重用；兩張都下載不是最少的做法。

options.text: No pictures, because a full-size copy already exists for each subject
options.zh: 不用下載，因為每個主題已有完整的圖片。
options.whyZh: R17 已經有完整圖，但線材標籤保存的是 C19 舊圖，不是此次需要的 C24；同一主題並不表示圖片 ID 相同。

explanationZh: R17 可使用〈工作間套件〉已存的同 ID 完整圖；C19 和 C24 是不同圖片，C24 不能用舊完整圖替代。〈手勢〉只有文字且已儲存。

vocabulary.note: 可否重用取決於原始 ID 是否相同，而不是檔案主題是否相近。

evidence: The export button gathers entries and pictures already saved on the device; it does not download missing files. It can reuse a full picture saved under another entry if both point to the same original picture ID. A preview badge shows only that the small version has been saved. A full-copy badge confirms a full picture for the ID shown alongside the badge. If an entry has no picture, saving the text is enough. / Inez has saved the text of all three entries for the trip. Reader Setup needs picture R17. It shows only a preview, but the unrelated Workshop Kit entry already has a full-copy badge for picture R17. Cable Labels needs picture C24. A full-size picture of the old set, C19, is still saved, and C24 has only a preview. Hand Signals has no picture. The team needs full pictures of every illustration referenced by the three selected entries, but has no need for the old label set.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The export button gathers entries and pictures already saved on the device; it does not download missing files. It can reuse a full picture saved under another entry if both point to the same original picture ID. A preview badge shows only that the small version has been saved. A full-copy badge confirms a full picture for the ID shown alongside the badge. If an entry has no picture, saving the text is enough.

Inez has saved the text of all three entries for the trip. Reader Setup needs picture R17. It shows only a preview, but the unrelated Workshop Kit entry already has a full-copy badge for picture R17. Cable Labels needs picture C24. A full-size picture of the old set, C19, is still saved, and C24 has only a preview. Hand Signals has no picture. The team needs full pictures of every illustration referenced by the three selected entries, but has no need for the old label set.
